reason: BallotReady rolled its 2021-2022 template forward and gives Arkansas municipal races a Feb 22 to Mar 1 window that was never a real 2026 filing period. Statutory municipal filing runs noon Jul 29 to noon Aug 5, 2026 (Arkansas SoS 2026 election calendar; A.C.A. 14-42-206), confirmed with the Carroll County clerk.
